## Summary

Adds MASTER-ARCH-001 to `ARCHITECTURE.md` as the system-of-systems contract layer.

### Added

- global Authority & Trust model
- Identity / credential / capability boundary
- decentralized Network / P2P architecture
- State & Data Ownership model
- decentralized Memory Federation boundary
- canonical API / interface and Event contracts
- Security architecture
- Blockchain / VM authority boundary
- Aurora / Agent authority invariants
- GlobusOS / ShivaCore boundaries
- Genesis / World runtime boundary
- Interoperability contract
- Deployment / topology roles
- Observability / Evidence pipeline
- Upgrade / Migration lifecycle
- Failure / Recovery lifecycle
- Governance boundary
- Compatibility / lifecycle matrix
- Resource / Compute boundary
- Disaster Recovery / Business Continuity boundary
- MASTER-ARCH-001 completeness gate

### Evidence rule

This PR is architecture-only. The document explicitly separates architecture contracts from implementation status. No module, service, protocol or runtime is claimed implemented merely because it is described here.

### Validation

Verified on branch `codex/master-arch-001-20260927` that the new MASTER-ARCH-001 sections are present in `ARCHITECTURE.md`, including Network, Identity, State, Memory, Interfaces/Events, Failure/Recovery and Compatibility contracts.
